transcript: Speaker A: beta, elephant ki spelling batao? [Son, spell elephant?] Speaker B: E-L-E-F-A-N-T. Speaker A: Galat! E-L-E-P-H-A-N-T hota hai. [Wrong! It is E-L-E-P-H-A-N-T.] Speaker B: Phoopha ji, mujhe khelne jana hai. [Uncle, I want to play.] Speaker A: Pehle rhinoceros ki spelling batao. [First spell rhinoceros.] Speaker A (VO): Bachha bhaag gaya. [The kid ran away.] My niece told me I make it feel like an exam. I realized I couldn't speak full sentences myself. She suggested I download English Seekho. I practiced 15 minutes daily with the AI coach. Next time, I spoke to them in English instead of testing them. They loved it. Download English Seekho now.
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer [Disclaimer text about the app not being affiliated with any government body].
summary: An uncle who used to alienate kids by testing their English spellings learns conversational English using the English Seekho app. By practicing 15 minutes daily with the AI coach, he successfully connects with his nieces and nephews. The ad encourages viewers to download the app to learn English through conversation.
